snippet.title: Capy Castaway - Developer Interview - FGS Live From gamescom
snippet.description:
An exclusive developer interview with Saffron Aurora, the creative director behind wholesome puzzle-adventure game, Capy Castaway, coming soon to PC. A demo is available now on Steam. 

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #capycastaway
